detail.summary: AER-4K2P9X. Identity confirmed via booking ref + surname. AK412 LHR-BCN 2026-08-04 was cancelled; operational cause WEATHER (extraordinary). Passenger Priya Raghunathan requested earliest same-day arrival (Gatwick acceptable). Rebooked own-carrier in same cabin to avoid inter-airport transfer: AK845 LHR-BCN 2026-08-04 ECONOMY, dep 09:15 local, arr 11:27 local, at £0 fare difference under S6.1/S6.3. Passenger reports purchasing breakfast and two coffees during the disruption and has receipts. Duty of care is triggered on cancellation regardless of cause (S4.1/S4.3). There is no tool to reimburse passenger-booked meals directly.
detail.requested_decision: Approve reimbursement of Priya Raghunathan’s reasonable meals/refreshments against itemised receipts, capped at £30 per passenger per 6-hour period per S4.2.
detail.recommendation: Authorise reimbursement on receipt submission up to the S4.2 cap. If receipts exceed the cap, pay to the cap only; consider goodwill above cap only if a separate, documented service failure is established under S11 (none claimed beyond a lack of information at the desk). Provide the passenger with instructions on where/how to submit the receipts.
detail.blocking_clause: S4.2 duty-of-care reimbursement required; no direct reimbursement tool exists for passenger-booked meals (tool gap).
